• In 2017, Kenya’s economic growth on a quarterly
basis was generally lower than in 2016.
• In 2017, the country faced a few shocks namely; a
drought in early 2017 and a slow down in economic
activity in the second half of the year due to the
pro-longed general elections
• This drop in the level of economic activity adversely
affected some of our banking business.
